title: Fughetta on a Lantern Theme
brief: Original baroque-style miniature for harpsichord and strings (two solo violins, viola, continuo cello, violone): a Grave introduction and a D minor Allegro fughetta whose voices imitate each other; about two minutes, hall acoustic, wide dynamics.

sections.intent: Grave: suspension chain over a falling bass, French sixth, Phrygian half cadence
Fughetta exposition: subject and answer from violin I down to the cello, codetta
Episode: circle of fifths with alternating prepared sevenths, viola runs the x figure
Middle entry in F major, violin II with the countersubject above
Harpsichord solo episode on the 8'+4' stop; head motif imitated by the strings
Middle entry in G minor in the cello, countersubject in the viola
Rising Monte sequence C7-F, D7-G, E7-A, imitation a beat apart
Dominant pedal with the head in stretto, violone joins
Final entry in the bass, countersubject on top, tutti
Cadence with trill, tonic pedal, Picardy third
